title: Bound for a restricted contribution
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, and choose $b\in\{0,1\}$. Let $f_b$ be the restriction to last coordinate $b$, let $d(x)=(f(x,0)-f(x,1))/2$, and let $U$ be the Gaussian profile equal to $\varphi(\Phi^{-1}(p))$ for $0<p<1$ and zero otherwise. If $U(\mathbb E f_b)\le B(f_b)$, where expectation is uniform on the cube and $B(g)=\mathbb E_x\sqrt{U(g(x))^2+\sum_i(D_i g(x))^2}$, then $\sqrt{U(\mathbb E f_b)^2+(\mathbb E d)^2}\le\mathbb E_x\sqrt{U(f(x,b))^2+\sum_{i<n+1}(D_i f(x,b))^2}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube of dimension $n+1$
replaced: For a real function $h$ on a uniform Boolean cube, put $B(h)=\mathbb E\sqrt{\overline I(h)^2+\sum_i(D_i h)^2}$, where $D_i$ is the coordinate half-difference and $\overline I$ is the Gaussian profile extended by zero outside $(0,1)$. For $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, put $f_b(x)=f(x,b)$ and $d=(f_0-f_1)/2$. If $\overline I(\mathbb E f_b)\le B(f_b)$, then $\sqrt{\overline I(\mathbb E f_b)^2+(\mathbb E d)^2}\le\mathbb E_x\sqrt{\overline I(f(x,b))^2+\sum_{i<n+1}(D_i f(x,b))^2}$.
